name: Limit points of Legendre-LP dual-feasible points have density 0
statement: Every limit point of Legendre-LP dual-feasible points is feasible at every real scale and has density 0, psi(t) <= 3 log2 t + 3.

name: Legendre-LP dual feasibility restricts along divisibility chains
statement: Feasibility of a Legendre-LP dual point at qx implies feasibility of its restriction at x.

name: Pointwise bound for the Moebius sum of one fixed cofinal sawtooth remainder
statement: Pointwise polylog bound for sum_k mu(k) r_b(x/k) for one fixed cofinal r_b. Uses the integers and all primes jointly; fails for DH, Liouville and theta^3 at Lambda_a >= 0; not separated from E_a at the level of exponents (returns 1/2 + a); only a mean-square bound is argued (MV-CAP).

name: Vaughan X^(1/4) forcing is a normalisation removable by two linear mollifier conditions
statement: The X^{1/4} Vaughan forcing equals -(4+2gamma) sqrt X M'(1) - zeta'(1/2) M'(1/2) and is removed by two linear conditions on the mollifier; residual |Xi'| <= (U + 32 sqrt U + 25)(6 + log X)/sqrt X.

name: Two-sided bound for the smallest eigenvalue of the Nyman-Beurling Gram matrix
statement: 1/(64*2^Omega_N*N^2) <= lam_min(G_N) <= (3+log N)/(N-1)^2; exponent exactly 2 up to N^o(1); p = 2 open. Same law for DH and periodic non-multiplicative sequences; carries no zero information.

name: Control SEL: twisted Selberg zeta of Gamma(2)
statement: Twisted Selberg zeta of Gamma(2): Euler product over geodesics, s <-> 1-s equation, real exceptional zeros off the line; lacks INT, order one, finite degree, sign of the zero side.

name: Selberg companion in Theorem PC has abscissa sigma* >= 1/2
statement: Any non-negative-coefficient coupling c Z'/Z + E with the PSL2(Z) Selberg zeta has sigma* >= 1/2; Theorem PC is silent at rho/2.

name: Control RZ_b: 1/zeta(s + 1 - b), 7/8 < b < 1
statement: RZ_b(s) = 1/zeta(s + 1 - b) = prod_p (1 - p^(b-1) p^-s) = sum mu(n) n^(b-1) n^-s. Log-derivative coefficients -n^(b-1) Lambda(n): a signed twist of Lambda with |eps_n| <= 1 (control TW-). Meromorphic on C, real zero at s = b (the pole of zeta), functional equation about Re s = b - 1/2 instead of 1/2. Has: Euler product, size, support, continuation. Lacks: Lambda >= 0, the integers (coefficients mu(n) n^(b-1)), symmetry line 1/2. Elementary; stated by the engine in batch 2, not refereed. Answers the open item of lane c1-missing-controls (a twist with a zero in 7/8 < Re s < 1); it needs infinitely many primes, as that lane noted.
